resume_text:
Professional Summary:
Results-oriented Data Engineer with 6+ years of specialized experience in data automation, big data pipelines, and analytics infrastructure. Highly proficient in SQL, ETL tools, Azure cloud services, and Power BI for enterprise reporting. Combines strong applied mathematics and industrial automation expertise with modern data engineering methodologies to extract, transform, load, and analyze complex datasets from industrial networks and enterprise databases, driving operational efficiency and high-impact business intelligence.

Skills:
Azure Data Platform (Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Blob Storage, Databricks), SQL & Database Management, Big Data Analytics, ETL / ELT Pipeline Architecture, Power BI & Data Visualization, Programming & Scripting (Python, Structured Text, Automation Scripts), Industrial IoT & Telemetry Networks, Data Modeling & Warehousing, Quality Assurance & Data Governance, Performance Optimization, Mathematical Modeling, Cross-Functional Team Leadership

Experience:
Company Name - Senior Data Automation & Engineering Manager (2020 – Present)
• Spearheaded data engineering and analytics transformation across distributed production systems, managing end-to-end data pipelines and integrating disparate operational data sources using SQL and Azure cloud tools.
• Architected robust ETL/ELT pipelines to extract high-frequency telemetric and operational data from machinery networks, streaming big data into centralized data lakes for downstream analytics.
• Designed and published comprehensive Power BI dashboards, providing real-time data analytics, performance metrics, and automated reporting that cut operational downtime by 24%.
• Governed data quality, schema evolution, and validation policies across enterprise reporting tools, ensuring 99.8% data accuracy for executive decision-making.

Company Name - Project Manager & Data Operations Lead (2017 – 2020)
• Managed data collection frameworks and programming logic for automated PLC and control networks, handling high-volume operational datasets across multiple industrial facilities.
• Developed SQL queries, stored procedures, and automated spreadsheet transformation workflows to aggregate production, budget, and material usage data.
• Collaborated with engineering and IT teams to implement data analytics workflows that reduced material waste and optimized budget variance by 18%.
• Delivered data-driven presentations and analytical models to senior leadership to guide strategic capacity planning and process automation.

Company Name - Automation & Systems Analyst (2015 – 2017)
• Extracted, validated, and analyzed machine performance data, designing standardized recording templates and database layouts for automated production tracking.
• Maintained network communications and data logging pipelines across precision manufacturing systems, ensuring consistent real-time telemetry capture.
• Applied mathematics and statistical analysis to benchmark equipment performance, identify bottlenecks, and support quality assurance initiatives.

Education:
Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Applied Mathematics & Engineering Technology | Accredited University / Institution
General Diploma | Technical Foundations & Systems

Certifications & Projects:
Certifications:
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (In Progress)
• Advanced SQL and Data Modeling Certification

Key Projects:
• Enterprise Industrial Big Data Pipeline: Built an end-to-end telemetry ingestion pipeline integrating IoT sensor streams into cloud storage, utilizing automated ETL scripts and Azure-based storage tiers.
• Operational Intelligence Power BI Suite: Engineered automated data models and real-time visualization dashboards serving cross-departmental stakeholders, reducing manual reporting hours by 35%.
